name: architecture-diagram-pair-benchmark
projection_rule: Projection fidelity compares the delivered visual with its own authoritative source. A fact absent from both source and visual is scored once as a semantic omission, not again as a projection omission.
operational_gates: The authoritative source parses or type-checks with the pair's already-available native tooling.
The delivered artifact opens in its documented native viewer.
The artifact contains no unsafe active content or undeclared network dependency.
Interactive paths, keyboard behavior, desktop width, and narrow width are exercised when applicable.
Mermaid source and its rendering use one pinned already-available renderer when rendering is part of the delivered experience.
critical_errors_reported_separately: synchronous response shown after asynchronous completion
fairness_controls: Use the same model and version, system instructions, evidence snapshot, user prompt, and read-only repository/tool access for both configurations.
Start every run in a fresh session and expose only the assigned visualization pair.
Apply equal token, wall-time, and tool-call ceilings, then report both quality under that user-cost budget and quality among successfully completed artifacts.
Do not prescribe TypeScript, HTML, or Mermaid in neutral cases; isolate explicit format requests in a separate format-fit stratum.
Grade authoritative source accuracy separately from rendered projection fidelity.
Rename submissions to random IDs, remove skill names/logs/validation claims, and randomize A/B order independently for every judge.
Preserve native formats because judges can be configuration-blind but not realistically format-blind.
Use at least three judges with mixed Mermaid and HTML experience and record their prior format preferences.
Score only atomic gold facts required by the prompt; do not reward raw node/edge count or a particular ontology.
Macro-average architecture families and requested view types so microservice cases do not dominate the result.

gold_fact_schema.adjudication: Two independent architects create and reconcile each fixture fact sheet before generation results are judged.

decision_rule.confidence_interval: 95% bootstrap interval over paired case/replicate score differences must exclude ±5 points.
decision_rule.catastrophic_error_guard: Do not declare a winner with a materially higher critical-error rate solely from its mean score.
decision_rule.otherwise: Report a capability profile by view and use case instead of one overall winner.
